Message.Name: Execution Report
Message.Description: Variants: Order Ack (6.11.6): Order Acknowledgement. Identified by: MsgType = 8 AND ExecType = ( 0 or L ) | IOC/FoK Order Cancel (6.11.7): Cancel of IOC or FOK order. Will always be sent last in a sequence following any immediate fills. Identified by: MsgType = 8 AND ExecType = 4 AND TimeInForce = 3 OR 4 | Market to Limit Order Cancel (6.11.8): Sent if a Market to Limit order cannot be immediately executed (nothing on opposite side of the order book). Identified by: MsgType = 8 AND ExecType = 4 AND OrdType = K | Order Reject (6.11.9): Order reject. Identified by: MsgType = 8 AND ExecType = 8 NOTE: This message lacks the required Side (54) field. NOTE 2: The Symbol field is set to [N/A]. | Cancel Replace Ack (6.11.10): Acknowledgement of Order Cancel Replace Request. Identified by: MsgType = 8 AND ExecType = 5 | Cancel Ack (6.11.11): Acknowledgement of Order Cancel Request. Identified by: MsgType = 8 AND ExecType = 4 | Unsolicited Cancel (6.11.12): Order was cancelled outside of FIX (via other protocol or by the marketplace). Identified by: MsgType = 8 AND ExecType = 4 AND ExecRestatementReason = 8 | Unsolicited Order Update (6.11.13): Order was updated outside of FIX (via other protocol or by the marketplace). Identified by: MsgType = 8 AND ExecType = D AND ExecRestatementReason = 8 | Restatement (6.11.14): Restatement of overnight (GTC/GTD) orders in the morning. Identified by: MsgType = 8 AND ExecType = D AND ExecRestatementReason = 1 | Fill (6.11.15): Order Fill. NOTE: For Multileg (Combination) order fills, see section 7.5.5. Identified by: MsgType = 8 AND ExecType = F | Order Suspended (6.11.16): Order Suspended (likely caused by temporary loss of connectivity). Identified by: MsgType = 8 AND ExecType = 9 | Expired (6.11.17): GTD or GTC Order Expired. For GTD orders the Expired transaction will be sent the day after the order expired. Order expiry can occur for GTC orders under certain conditions. See Order Expiry section for details. Identified by: MsgType = 8 AND ExecType = C | Combination Order Fill (7.5.6): Combination Order Fill. Identified by: MsgType = 8 AND ExecType = F AND MultiLegReportingType = 3 Req' | Fill (10.2.12): Order Fill. Identified by: MsgType = 8 AND ExecType = F
